questions.q: Name two ways in which a magnet can lose its magnetism.
questions.answer: A magnet loses its magnetism if it is heated strongly or hammered or dropped repeatedly.
questions.explanation: These disturb the tiny magnetic parts.

questions.q: A student wants to separate iron and aluminium screws from a mixed pile. How can she do this?
questions.answer: Move a magnet over the pile. The iron screws will stick to it, and the aluminium screws will stay behind.
questions.explanation: Aluminium is non-magnetic.

questions.q: Why are bar magnets stored in pairs with a piece of soft iron called a keeper across the ends?
questions.answer: The keepers help the magnets to keep their strength for a long time.
questions.explanation: Proper storage prevents weakening.
